[[File:CeruleanGemstone-SW100Objects.png|thumb|250px|Kashyyyk clarion with inlaid three cerulean gems]]
'''Cerulean gemstones''' were the bright green, dark green or blackish green gems used by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] in their item ornamentation and decorations. Some gems of this kind were embedded in [[Kashyyyk clarion/Legends|Kashyyyk clarions]], [[ceremonial pipe]]s, elder staves, battle shields and other items valued by Wookiees.

==Behind the scenes==
Cerulean gemstones resemble [[Wikipedia:malachite|malachite]] both in color and structure.
